# Diggi Palace

> Diggi Palace is a heritage palace hotel in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India — an ancestral family palace built in 1860 that has been welcoming guests as a hotel since 1991. It is classified as a heritage hotel by the Government of India and is one of the few heritage properties directly linked to the origin of a major literary festival: the Jaipur Literature Festival was founded in 2006 and held its earliest editions in the courtyards of Diggi Palace.

## Key facts

- Name: Diggi Palace (also: Hotel Diggi Palace, Diggi Palace Jaipur)
- Founded: 1860, ancestral seat of the Diggi principality of Rajasthan
- Opened as a hotel: 1991
- Address: Shivaji Marg, C-Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302004, India
- Phone: +91-93521-45034
- Email: crs@hoteldiggipalace.com
- Website: https://www.hoteldiggipalace.com/
- Distance from Jaipur International Airport (Sanganer): ~18 km, 30–40 minutes by road
- Room categories: Heritage Standard, Heritage Deluxe, Courtyard Suite, Palace Suite
- Dining: Baradari Restaurant (Rajasthani royal thali, fine dining), La Brass (all-day global/Indian bistro)
- Event venues: Durbar Hall (up to 500 guests), Green Sanctuary garden (up to 300 guests), Zenana Courtyard (up to 80 guests) — used for weddings, receptions and cultural events
- Pet-friendly: yes
- Check-in: 2:00 PM · Check-out: 11:00 AM

## Notable

Diggi Palace is the historic home ground of the Jaipur Literature Festival (JLF), one of the world's largest free literary festivals, which held many of its early editions in the palace's courtyards starting in 2006.
